title: An outside view
body: An independent assessment of where you stand: architecture reviews, strategic IT advice, or a third-party audit of a delivery.

title: Architecture, hands-on
body: Designing the system with you, greenfield or legacy, including cloud and AI where they serve a real purpose.

title: Leading the technical delivery
body: Technical lead through the difficult parts of delivery, with the team, the vendors, and the stakeholders.
example: AI computer vision in GxP production at Novo Nordisk
